name: sequential-thinking
licenseQuote: The MCP project is undergoing a licensing transition from the MIT License to the Apache License, Version 2.0 ("Apache-2.0"). ... Contributions made by authors who originally licensed their work under the MIT License ... remain licensed under the MIT License. (file then holds the Apache-2.0 text; no single copyright line; docs are CC-BY-4.0 but not run)
summaryEn: Lets the model work through a problem in revisable, branching thought steps.
summaryKo: 문제를 단계별로 나눠 생각하고, 필요하면 되돌리거나 갈라서 풀어요.
guideEn: Single tool `sequentialthinking`. Call it repeatedly; each call gives one thought with thought, thoughtNumber, totalThoughts and nextThoughtNeeded, and may set isRevision or branchFromThought. Keep calling until nextThoughtNeeded is false.
guideKo: 도구는 `sequentialthinking` 하나예요. 생각 한 단계마다 thought, thoughtNumber, totalThoughts, nextThoughtNeeded를 넣어 계속 부르고, 고치거나 갈라야 하면 isRevision이나 branchFromThought를 써요. nextThoughtNeeded가 false가 되면 끝내요.
warningsEn: Needs Node.js 24 or later (npm engines and README).
Thoughts are printed to stderr unless DISABLE_THOUGHT_LOGGING=true, which this entry sets.
warningsKo: Node.js 24 이상이 필요해요.
생각 내용이 stderr 로그에 찍히는데, 이 항목은 DISABLE_THOUGHT_LOGGING=true로 꺼 둬요.
runEvidence: README: "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking"]; "Node.js 24 or later, when the server runs through `npx` or from source." npm bin mcp-server-sequential-thinking (single bin, so npx resolves it); lib.ts reads DISABLE_THOUGHT_LOGGING.
concerns: No telemetry code in src/sequentialthinking (grep for telemetry/posthog empty). npm license field is 'SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE' (mixed MIT/Apache-2.0 transition text, both accepted); repo-level docs are CC-BY-4.0 but only code is run.
reason: Official reference server, tiny, no account, no telemetry.
problems: Added env DISABLE_THOUGHT_LOGGING=true (lib.ts) so thoughts are not logged
Licence is a mixed MIT/Apache-2.0 transition text, noted in licenseQuote
checked: Read LICENSE, README, lib.ts, package.json, npm registry (bin, engines), git ls-remote matches

name: duckdb
summaryEn: Runs SQL on DuckDB, including CSV and Parquet files.
summaryKo: DuckDB로 CSV, Parquet 데이터를 SQL로 분석해요.
guideEn: Tools: `execute_query` (DuckDB SQL), `list_databases`, `list_tables`, `list_columns`, plus `switch_database_connection` only with --allow-switch-databases. This entry uses an in-memory database with --read-write; for an existing file use --db-path /path/to.duckdb without --read-write (read-only). List tables and columns before querying.
guideKo: 도구는 `execute_query`(DuckDB SQL), `list_databases`, `list_tables`, `list_columns`이고, `switch_database_connection`은 --allow-switch-databases를 줄 때만 있어요. 이 항목은 메모리 DB에 --read-write로 시작해요. 기존 파일은 --read-write 없이 --db-path에 .duckdb 경로를 주면 읽기 전용이에요. 쿼리 전에 테이블과 컬럼부터 봐요.
warningsEn: The in-memory database is empty and lost on exit; point --db-path at a .duckdb file (without --read-write) to query existing data read-only.
README warns that read-only mode still allows local file access and DuckDB settings changes; do not expose it to third parties.
md: paths use a MotherDuck cloud account and token; this entry does not.
warningsKo: 메모리 DB는 비어 있고 끝나면 사라져요. 기존 데이터는 --read-write 없이 --db-path에 .duckdb 파일을 줘서 읽기 전용으로 봐요.
읽기 전용이어도 로컬 파일 접근과 DuckDB 설정 변경은 가능하니 남에게 열어 주지 말아요.
md: 경로는 MotherDuck 클라우드 계정과 토큰이 필요하지만 이 항목은 쓰지 않아요.
runEvidence: README: claude mcp add --scope user duckdb --transport stdio -- uvx mcp-server-motherduck --db-path :memory: --read-write --allow-switch-databases; read-only file example args ["mcp-server-motherduck","--db-path","/absolute/path/to/your.duckdb"]; pyproject [project.scripts] mcp-server-motherduck.
concerns: No telemetry/posthog/sentry hits in src or pyproject (only uv.lock). Vendor is MotherDuck but the server works on local DuckDB without an account.
reason: Official, MIT, works locally with no account.
problems: Proposer claimed 'default is read-only'; README only shows read-only for a file path, and :memory: examples all use --read-write. Changed to :memory: --read-write and explained read-only usage
Summary said 'local DuckDB files'; with an in-memory default reworded
Added the README's local file access caveat
checked: Read LICENSE, README, pyproject scripts, grep telemetry, PyPI json (version, requires_python), git ls-remote matches

name: svelte
summaryEn: Official Svelte docs and a static checker for generated Svelte code.
summaryKo: Svelte 공식 문서를 찾고, 만든 코드를 정적 분석으로 고쳐줘요.
guideEn: Tools: `list-sections` to see available docs, `get-documentation` for the sections you pick, `svelte-autofixer` on generated code until no issues remain, `playground-link` for a playground URL. The same commands also run as a CLI: npx -y @sveltejs/mcp <command>.
guideKo: 도구는 `list-sections`(문서 목록), `get-documentation`(고른 섹션 문서), `svelte-autofixer`(만든 코드를 문제 없을 때까지 점검), `playground-link`(플레이그라운드 링크)예요. 같은 명령을 CLI로도 쓸 수 있어요(npx -y @sveltejs/mcp <명령>).
warningsEn: Documentation is fetched over the network from svelte.dev.
warningsKo: 문서는 svelte.dev에서 네트워크로 가져와요.
runEvidence: documentation/docs/30-mcp/70-cli.md: `npx -y @sveltejs/mcp` launches the local stdio MCP server; npm bin svelte-mcp (single bin).
concerns: The `track` hook (usage events) exists only in the shared mcp-server package and is passed in by the hosted apps/mcp-remote; grep of packages/mcp-stdio/src finds no custom/track, so the npx stdio server sends no usage events. Not run.
reason: Official Svelte project, MIT, active, no account.
problems: Dropped the unverified 'playground code is only in the URL' claim and the hosted URL sentence from guide
checked: Read LICENSE, docs 70-cli.md, handlers/tools, grep track in mcp-stdio, npm registry (bin, license), git ls-remote matches

name: mobile-mcp
licenseQuote: Apache License / Version 2.0, January 2004 (full text, no copyright line)
summaryEn: Drives iOS and Android simulators, emulators and real devices.
summaryKo: iOS와 Android 시뮬레이터, 에뮬레이터, 실제 기기를 조작해요.
capabilities: take screenshots and read on-screen elements
guideEn: Start with `mobile_list_available_devices`, then `mobile_list_elements_on_screen` or `mobile_take_screenshot` to see the screen, then act with `mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates`, `mobile_swipe_on_screen`, `mobile_type_keys`, `mobile_press_button`. Use `mobile_launch_app` and `mobile_list_apps` for apps.
guideKo: 먼저 `mobile_list_available_devices`로 기기를 보고, `mobile_list_elements_on_screen`이나 `mobile_take_screenshot`으로 화면을 확인한 뒤 `mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates`, `mobile_swipe_on_screen`, `mobile_type_keys`, `mobile_press_button`으로 조작해요. 앱은 `mobile_launch_app`, `mobile_list_apps`로 다뤄요.
warningsEn: A simulator, emulator or device must already be running (Xcode simulator, Android with adb); real iOS devices need extra tools.
It controls the device and can install or uninstall apps and clear app data.
Anonymous telemetry (PostHog, Scarf) is on by default; this entry sets MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1.
warningsKo: Xcode 시뮬레이터나 adb로 연결된 안드로이드 기기가 먼저 떠 있어야 해요. 실제 iOS 기기는 추가 도구가 필요해요.
기기를 직접 조작하고 앱 설치, 삭제, 데이터 삭제도 할 수 있어요.
익명 사용 통계(PostHog, Scarf)가 기본으로 켜져 있어서 이 항목은 MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1로 꺼 둬요.
runEvidence: README: `claude mcp add mobile-mcp -- npx -y @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest`; src/server.ts returns early from posthog() and scarf() when MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY is set; npm bin mcp-server-mobile.
concerns: server.ts sends PostHog events and a Scarf pixel unless MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY is set (switch confirmed in source; the get_more_tools tool, which sends context to the developers, is not registered when it is set). Optional cloud-device tools exist (mobile_login_to_cloud_provider).
reason: Official, Apache-2.0, active; telemetry off switch is set in env.
problems: Confirmed the telemetry off switch in src/server.ts lines 180, 231, 324
Dropped the unchecked 'go-ios, WebDriverAgent' names from the warning
checked: Read LICENSE, README run lines, src/server.ts telemetry and tool names, npm registry (bin, license), git ls-remote matches

name: grafana
licenseQuote: Apache License / Version 2.0, January 2004 (full text, no copyright line)
summaryEn: Searches Grafana dashboards, and queries Prometheus, Loki and alerts.
summaryKo: Grafana 대시보드를 찾고 Prometheus, Loki 로그, 알림을 조회해요.
guideEn: Set GRAFANA_URL and a service account token. Find datasources and dashboards first, then use the Prometheus and Loki query tools; dashboard tools can return a summary or apply a patch instead of full JSON. Some categories (for example run panel query, agent observability, admin) are off by default and need `--enabled-tools`.
guideKo: GRAFANA_URL과 서비스 계정 토큰을 먼저 정해요. 데이터소스와 대시보드를 찾은 뒤 Prometheus와 Loki 쿼리 도구로 조회해요. 대시보드 도구는 전체 JSON 대신 요약을 받거나 일부만 패치할 수 있어요. 일부 도구(패널 쿼리 실행, 에이전트 관측, 관리자 등)는 기본으로 꺼져 있어서 `--enabled-tools`로 켜야 해요.
warningsEn: Needs a Grafana instance and a service account token (self-hosted or Grafana Cloud).
Dashboard patch and alert tools can change your Grafana; give the token only the roles you want (or add --disable-write).
Anonymous usage statistics go to Grafana Labs by default; this entry sets GRAFANA_USAGE_STATS=disabled.
warningsKo: Grafana 서버와 서비스 계정 토큰이 필요해요(자체 호스팅 또는 Grafana Cloud).
대시보드 패치 같은 도구는 Grafana를 바꿀 수 있어서 토큰 권한을 필요한 만큼만 줘요(--disable-write도 가능해요).
익명 사용 통계가 기본으로 Grafana Labs에 가는데, 이 항목은 GRAFANA_USAGE_STATS=disabled로 꺼 둬요.
runEvidence: README Quick Start: "command": "uvx", "args": ["mcp-grafana"], "env": {"GRAFANA_URL": "http://localhost:3000", "GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN": "<your service account token>"}; PyPI mcp-grafana 2.2.0 Apache-2.0 homepage grafana/mcp-grafana.
concerns: Proposer missed usage telemetry: usagestats/ reports anonymous events to stats.grafana.org by default (docs/sources/anonymous-usage-statistics.md: 'enabled by default'). Off switches in usagestats/mode.go: GRAFANA_USAGE_STATS (--usage-stats) set to a non-enabled value resolves to disabled, or DO_NOT_TRACK=1. Set in env. Did not run it; --disable-write flag mentioned in README text I saw only for the assistant tools.
reason: Official Grafana Labs server, Apache-2.0, very active; telemetry has a documented off switch set in env.
problems: Proposer said no usage telemetry; there is one, on by default (usagestats package). Added GRAFANA_USAGE_STATS=disabled to env and a warning
Removed the unverified tool name query_prometheus ordering claim by describing tools generically
Added admin to the default-off categories (README line 530)
checked: Read LICENSE, README quick start and flags, usagestats/mode.go and docs page, PyPI json, git ls-remote matches

name: mobilebuild
summaryEn: Builds, runs and debugs iOS and macOS apps with Xcode (formerly XcodeBuildMCP).
summaryKo: Xcode로 iOS와 macOS 앱을 빌드하고 실행하고 디버깅해요. (예전 이름 XcodeBuildMCP)
guideEn: Run `mobilebuildmcp tools` (CLI) or list the MCP tools to see what exists. Typical flow: discover the project or workspace and schemes, build, run on a simulator, then inspect the screen. Device tools need code signing set up in Xcode.
guideKo: `mobilebuildmcp tools`(CLI)나 MCP 도구 목록으로 어떤 도구가 있는지 먼저 봐요. 보통은 프로젝트와 스킴을 찾고, 빌드하고, 시뮬레이터에서 실행한 뒤 화면을 확인해요. 실제 기기는 Xcode 코드 서명이 먼저 필요해요.
warningsEn: Runs on macOS with Xcode only; it runs xcodebuild and can launch apps on simulators or devices.
Now maintained under getsentry and renamed MobileBuildMCP (old npm name xcodebuildmcp); runtime error reports go to Sentry unless MOBILEBUILDMCP_SENTRY_DISABLED=true, which this entry sets.
warningsKo: macOS와 Xcode에서만 돌아가고, xcodebuild를 실행하며 시뮬레이터나 기기에서 앱을 띄워요.
getsentry로 옮겨져 MobileBuildMCP로 이름이 바뀌었고(예전 npm 이름 xcodebuildmcp), 런타임 오류 보고가 Sentry로 가는데 이 항목은 MOBILEBUILDMCP_SENTRY_DISABLED=true로 꺼 둬요.
runEvidence: README: "Most clients can also run the MCP server on demand via `npx -y mobilebuildmcp@latest mcp` without a global install."; npm mobilebuildmcp@2.7.1 bin mobilebuildmcp; src/utils/sentry-config.ts reads MOBILEBUILDMCP_SENTRY_DISABLED === 'true'.
concerns: README says Sentry is used for internal runtime error telemetry only and links a docs page I could not open; the off switch is confirmed in src/utils/sentry-config.ts. The tool names and 'tools' CLI subcommand were not individually verified (README links to tools.mdx in another repo). Version requirements (macOS 14.5, Xcode 16) not re-verified; README badge shows Xcode 16. The cloneDir name is the old getsentry/XcodeBuildMCP clone (same commit as git ls-remote of MobileBuildMCP).
reason: Best-known Xcode server, MIT, active; off switch confirmed in source and set in env.
problems: Dropped unverified 'macOS 14.5+' number from the warning (README badge only shows Xcode 16)
Pointed cloneDir at getsentry__XcodeBuildMCP, which is the clone whose remote matches
Off switch confirmed in source, not in README
checked: Read LICENSE, README, sentry-config.ts, npm registry for mobilebuildmcp and xcodebuildmcp, git ls-remote matches clone commit

name: eslint
licenseQuote: Apache License / Version 2.0, January 2004 (repo LICENSE, full text, no copyright line; packages/mcp/README: "Apache 2.0")
summaryEn: Official ESLint server that lints files in your project.
summaryKo: ESLint 공식 서버로 프로젝트 파일을 린트해요.
capabilities: lint files with the project's ESLint config
guideEn: Single tool `lint-files`: pass file paths and it returns ESLint results using the project's config. Run it from the project folder. The same server also starts with `npx eslint --mcp`.
guideKo: 도구는 `lint-files` 하나예요. 파일 경로 목록을 주면 프로젝트 ESLint 설정으로 결과를 돌려줘요. 프로젝트 폴더에서 실행해요. `npx eslint --mcp`로도 같은 서버를 시작할 수 있어요.
warningsEn: Runs ESLint, so your eslint.config and plugins are executed.
Run it from the project folder so the right ESLint config is found.
warningsKo: ESLint를 실행하므로 설정 파일과 플러그인 코드가 실행돼요.
올바른 설정을 찾도록 프로젝트 폴더에서 실행해요.
runEvidence: packages/mcp/README: `npx @eslint/mcp` and `npx eslint --mcp`; npm @eslint/mcp@0.3.16 Apache-2.0 bin mcp; src/mcp-server.js registers "lint-files".
concerns: No telemetry hits in packages/mcp. Proposer's jiti/TypeScript-config advice and 'absolute paths' were not found in the package README and were removed.
problems: Removed unverified jiti / TypeScript config warning and 'absolute' path claim
Source lives in eslint/rewrite packages/mcp (npm repository directory confirms)
checked: Read LICENSE, packages/mcp README and src, grep telemetry, npm registry (bin, license, engines), git ls-remote matches

name: shadcn
summaryEn: Browses and adds shadcn/ui components and other registries' items.
summaryKo: shadcn/ui 컴포넌트와 다른 레지스트리 항목을 찾아 프로젝트에 추가해요.
guideEn: Tools: `get_project_registries`, `search_items_in_registries`, `list_items_in_registries`, `view_items_in_registries`, `get_item_examples_from_registries`, `get_add_command_for_items`, `get_audit_checklist`. Search, view the item, then get the add command and run it in the project.
guideKo: 도구는 `get_project_registries`, `search_items_in_registries`, `list_items_in_registries`, `view_items_in_registries`, `get_item_examples_from_registries`, `get_add_command_for_items`, `get_audit_checklist`예요. 검색하고 항목을 본 뒤, 추가 명령을 받아 프로젝트에서 실행해요.
warningsEn: Meant for a project that has a components.json; the add commands it returns change your project when you run them.
warningsKo: components.json이 있는 프로젝트용이고, 돌려주는 추가 명령은 실행하면 프로젝트를 바꿔요.

concerns: No telemetry hits in packages/shadcn/src. The literal command `shadcn@latest mcp` (what init writes) was not seen as a config block in the docs I grepped; init output was not inspected. Tool names read from source, not run.
reason: Official, MIT, popular UI library server.
problems: Added -y to npx so it does not prompt
Removed unverified 'private registries may need tokens' claim
Exact args written by `mcp init` not confirmed; `shadcn mcp` subcommand follows from the init doc and the server code

name: laravel-boost
licenseQuote: The MIT License (MIT) / Copyright (c) Taylor Otwell
summaryEn: Gives AI agents Laravel docs, the database, logs and Tinker for your app.
summaryKo: Laravel 앱의 문서, 데이터베이스, 로그, Tinker를 AI가 쓰게 해줘요.
capabilities: read log entries and last error
guideEn: Add it to the Laravel app as a dev dependency and run `php artisan boost:install`, which writes the MCP config; the server itself starts with `php artisan boost:mcp` from the project folder. Tool classes in src/Mcp/Tools: SearchDocs, DatabaseSchema, DatabaseQuery, DatabaseConnections, ReadLogEntries, LastError, BrowserLogs, Tinker, GetAbsoluteUrl.
guideKo: Laravel 앱에 개발용 의존성으로 추가하고 `php artisan boost:install`을 실행하면 MCP 설정이 써져요. 서버는 프로젝트 폴더에서 `php artisan boost:mcp`로 시작해요. 도구는 SearchDocs, DatabaseSchema, DatabaseQuery, DatabaseConnections, ReadLogEntries, LastError, BrowserLogs, Tinker, GetAbsoluteUrl이에요.
warningsEn: Needs PHP 8.2+ (composer.json) and a Laravel app managed with Composer.
Tinker runs PHP code inside your app and the database tools read your data; use it in development only.
The `composer require` line is not in the repo (the README only links to laravel.com/docs/boost); check those docs if it fails.
warningsKo: PHP 8.2 이상(composer.json)과 Composer로 만든 Laravel 앱이 필요해요.
Tinker는 앱 안에서 PHP 코드를 실행하고 DB 도구는 데이터를 읽으니 개발 환경에서만 써요.
`composer require` 줄은 저장소에 적혀 있지 않아요(README는 laravel.com/docs/boost 링크뿐). 안 되면 그 문서를 봐요.
runEvidence: src/Install/McpWriter.php writes args [php, artisan, boost:mcp]; src/Console/StartCommand.php: #[AsCommand('boost:mcp', ...)]; src/Console/InstallCommand.php signature boost:install; composer.json name laravel/boost, php ^8.2.
concerns: No telemetry/analytics hits in src. Package is on Packagist (README badges), no npm/PyPI package. The composer require command is by convention (package name confirmed in composer.json), not quoted from a repo file.
reason: Official Laravel project, MIT, very active.
problems: Install line 'composer require laravel/boost --dev' not stated in the repo; package name and boost:install confirmed in source
README is only a link to laravel.com docs, so the guide describes the install in source terms
checked: Read LICENSE.md, README, composer.json, McpWriter.php, StartCommand.php, InstallCommand.php, Tools folder, grep telemetry, git ls-remote matches

name: mongodb
licenseQuote: Apache License / Version 2.0, January 2004 (full text, no copyright line)
summaryEn: Queries and inspects MongoDB databases, read-only by default here.
summaryKo: MongoDB 데이터베이스를 조회하고 살펴봐요. 여기서는 읽기 전용으로 시작해요.
guideEn: Give a connection string in MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING (or connect with the connect tool). Explore databases and collections first, then query. `--readOnly` is in this entry; remove it only if the model should create, update or delete.
guideKo: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING에 연결 문자열을 넣어요(없으면 connect 도구로 연결). 데이터베이스와 컬렉션을 먼저 둘러본 뒤 조회해요. 이 항목엔 `--readOnly`가 들어 있고, 쓰기가 필요할 때만 빼요.
warningsEn: Needs a MongoDB connection string (local or Atlas).
Without --readOnly the model can change or delete data.
Telemetry is on by default (README); this entry sets MDB_MCP_TELEMETRY=disabled and DO_NOT_TRACK=1.
warningsKo: MongoDB 연결 문자열이 필요해요(로컬 또는 Atlas).
--readOnly를 빼면 데이터를 바꾸거나 지울 수 있어요.
